newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Island changes rights ratio to five-for-two.
newsitem.headline: Island changes rights ratio to five-for-two.

text.p: The Philippines' Island Mining & Industrial Corp said on Monday its board had approved a change in its stock rights offering ratio to five for every two shares held.
The company earlier said it planned to sell two new shares for every share held.
The new shares will be offered at one peso per share. Island was untraded on Monday. It closed at 3.10 centavos last Thursday.
Twenty-five percent of the amount will be due upon subscription, while the balance is payable prior to the listing.
